name.en: BDC Capital — Deep Tech Venture Fund

strategy.thesis: Canada's largest VC fund dedicated entirely to deep tech, backing early-stage companies in quantum, photonics, electronics, foundational AI, advanced materials and robotics. The fund is closed to new investments and now supports its existing portfolio.

summary.en: BDC Capital's $200M Deep Tech Venture Fund, launched in 2021, is Canada's largest VC vehicle dedicated entirely to deep tech — quantum, photonics, electronics, foundational AI and robotics. Now closed to new investments and focused on its existing portfolio.
summary.local: Le Fonds pour les technologies profondes de 200 M$ de BDC Capital, lancé en 2021, est le plus important fonds de capital de risque canadien entièrement consacré aux technologies profondes.

name.en: BDC Capital — Industrial Innovation Venture Fund

strategy.thesis: Invests in early-stage, high-growth companies developing transformative solutions in advanced manufacturing, robotics, automation, applied AI, industrial software, ag-tech/food-tech, mining/extractive industries and (in Fund II) critical minerals.

summary.en: BDC Capital's Industrial Innovation Venture Fund backs Canadian companies building robotics, automation, applied AI and industrial/hardware tech for legacy industries. Fund I (2019) was $250M and backed 20 companies; Fund II ($200M) launched August 2025 with an added focus on critical minerals.
summary.local: Le Fonds d'innovation industrielle de BDC Capital appuie les entreprises canadiennes en robotique, automatisation, IA appliquée et technologies industrielles.

strategy.thesis: "Engineers funding engineers" — RiSC backs Canadian deep tech startups at pre-seed and seed, focusing on technically challenging ventures in robotics, drones, ML and advanced hardware that mainstream investors find hard to evaluate.

application.how_to_apply: Submit the application form on risc.capital with a description of the technology, the problem it solves and the business model; the firm responds within two weeks.

summary.en: Toronto-based pre-seed/seed deep tech fund founded in 2019 by Scott Pelton and Colin Webster (backed by Shopify co-founder Scott Lake). 'Engineers funding engineers' — invests $250K–$750K in Canadian robotics, drones, ML and advanced-hardware startups.

strategy.thesis: Canada's first quantum-focused VC fund, investing pre-seed/seed in startups across quantum computing, communications, sensors and materials, plus technologies critical to the quantum supply chain. Targets ~20 companies over five years, mostly in Quebec.

summary.en: Sherbrooke-based Quantacet is Canada's first quantum-focused VC fund. Its $20M Fund I (first close 2024) invests pre-seed/seed in quantum computing, communications, sensors and materials startups, mostly in Quebec, with $10M from Investissement Québec.
summary.local: Basé à Sherbrooke, Quantacet est le premier fonds de capital de risque canadien dédié aux technologies quantiques. Son fonds de 20 M$ (première clôture 2024) investit en préamorçage et amorçage.

strategy.thesis: Provides commercialization funding, expertise and support for researchers and entrepreneurs whose breakthroughs in Quantum Information Science can lead to new commercializable technologies — anchoring Waterloo's 'Quantum Valley' alongside IQC and the Perimeter Institute.

summary.en: Waterloo-based Quantum Valley Investments is a $100M private fund founded in 2013 by BlackBerry co-founders Mike Lazaridis and Doug Fregin to commercialize quantum information science breakthroughs, anchoring the 'Quantum Valley' cluster.

strategy.thesis: Quebec's first VC fund dedicated specifically to deep tech, investing pre-seed/seed in startups in AI, medtech, Industry 4.0 (manufacturing/robotics) and connected objects — many emerging from the Centech incubator.

summary.en: Montreal-based Boreal Ventures, partnered with the Centech incubator, launched a $26M Fund I in 2021 — Quebec's first VC fund dedicated to deep tech. It invests pre-seed/seed in AI, medtech, Industry 4.0 and connected objects.
summary.local: Basé à Montréal et associé à l'incubateur Centech, Boreal Ventures a lancé un fonds de 26 M$ en 2021 — le premier fonds de capital de risque québécois dédié aux technologies profondes.

strategy.thesis: "Deep tech for good" — leads seed rounds in early-stage Canadian deep tech startups (human-machine interface, robotics, AI, IoT, advanced materials, photonics) that have a positive social or environmental impact.

summary.en: Montreal-based Innovobot Resonance Ventures (IRV) is the VC arm of the Innovobot innovation platform. Its 'deep tech for good' fund targets $40M CAD ($14M first close) and leads $500K–$2M seed rounds in robotics, HMI, AI and advanced-materials startups with positive impact.

strategy.thesis: Canada's first and only incubator dedicated to hardware and semiconductor startups, providing prototyping/testing labs, mentorship and investor access (no equity taken). Paired with the HardTech Investor Network, Canada's only hardware/deep-tech-focused investor network.

summary.en: ventureLAB's Hardware Catalyst Initiative (Markham, ON) is Canada's first and only incubator dedicated to hardware and semiconductor startups. It takes no equity, gives access to $12M+ prototyping labs, and has supported 95 startups that created 728 jobs and raised $82M. Its HardTech Investor Network (launched 2023) is Canada's only hardware/deep-tech investor network.
